[EN] For lancers, combat can be deceptively simple, but what you must remember is that our fighting style only looks simplistic.

By using glyphs, your victories will pile up at your feet.
[ES] Para los Lancers, el combate puede parecer engañosamente simple, pero debes recordar que nuestro estilo de lucha solo lo parece.

Al usar glifos, tus victorias se acumularán a tus pies.
